experiment_data.hypothesis: CED scoring (NLI-based contrastive discrimination) on LLaMA-3.1-8B RSFT candidates will produce filtered training data that improves RSFT quality, consistent with Qwen3-4B CED results.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python -m freige.training.rsft_score_filter --input_dir /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_candidates_llama_3_1_8b --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_scored_llama_3_1_8b --nli_model_path cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-base --nli_device cuda:0 --scoring_mode ced --tau 0.5 --selection_strategy top_k --top_k 3"
